committed_active_assignments.title: Close Bridge identity and bounded-input security gaps
acceptance: Using public fixture keys, reproduce the baseline NIP-46 session-manager acceptance of a changed user signing key and of a foreign signed transport author delivered by an adapter; distinguish this conditional handler gap from exploitability of the default adapter. Resolve and bind user identity separately from transport identity; reject unauthorized identity changes and mixed-session/replay responses.

Reproduce SerialLineStreamPort retaining 20,000 queued bytes from 10,000 short lines with maxBufferedBytes=4; enforce total bytes and request count, backpressure, terminal-error behavior and cleanup, not only per-line limits.

committed_active_assignments.title: Constrain secret ownership and cryptographic implementation
acceptance: Remove secret-bearing Debug and unnecessary Clone/public secret access; test exposed formatting behavior using public fixture material.
Define lifetimes, copies, zeroization boundaries and internal-memory allocation; do not claim compiler-proof physical erasure from ownership alone.

Select maintained crypto/zeroization candidates using independent vectors, pinned features and no_std compile plus final-link probes for the first target; qualify every actual device in its own implementation/release task, not as a universal prerequisite.

Test raw BIP-340 event-digest signing and NIP-44 unhashed shared-x derivation explicitly; high-level prehash and generic ECDH helpers are not interchangeable. Preserve C/Rust ABI link failures and exact corrected flags when evaluating a C backend.

Specify the entropy-provider boundary and failure contract, including FFI/weak-symbol/runtime fallback risks; define how source-to-final-binary provenance and actual provider invocation will be checked in each device gate.

committed_active_assignments.title: Qualify the required stable KiCad operations and automation path
acceptance: Pin KiCad 10.0.7 and adapter revision after checking current support; begin with read-only operations.

On disposable projects qualify each actually required operation and its rollback/save/reopen semantics; coordinate/layer/flip/crash tests apply to operations being enabled. Unused adapter capabilities are not prerequisites for schematic capture.
Use native-project CLI ERC/DRC and hash-linked exports; distinguish stable PCB IPC from development-only schematic/headless features.
Promote only demonstrated operations; retain one writer per CAD project and independently reviewed source-generation fallback.

Require a clean pinned dependency installation or a fully reviewed maintained correction; a new binding combination does not inherit old runtime evidence. Native CLI and independently reviewed source generation can unblock required CAD work while extra MCP operations remain disabled.
